message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, grouped by region:

| Region | Airport (IATA) | City | State | Notable Features |
|--------|----------------|------|-------|------------------|
| **East Coast** | JFK (John F. Kennedy International) | New York City | NY | Largest international gateway in NYC; major hub for American Airlines. |
| | BOS (Logan International) | Boston | MA | Hub for JetBlue and Delta; close to historic sites. |
| | IAD (Washington Dulles) | Washington, D.C. | VA | Major hub for United Airlines; serves the nation's capital. |
| | ATL (Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International) | Atlanta | GA | World's busiest airport by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta. |
| **South** | MCO (Orlando International) | Orlando | FL | Key gateway to theme parks; hub for Southwest. |
| | DFW (Dallas/Fort Worth International) | Dallas/Fort Worth | TX | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the largest airports in the world. |
| | DEN (Denver International) | Denver | CO | Largest airport in Colorado; hub for United and Southwest. |
| **Midwest** | ORD (O'Hare International) | Chicago | IL | One of the busiest airports worldwide; hub for United and American. |
| | MSP (Minneapolis–Saint Paul International) | Minneapolis | MN | Hub for Delta; known for excellent customer service. |
| | CLT (Charlotte Douglas International) | Charlotte | NC | Major hub for American Airlines; growing cargo hub. |
| **West** | LAX (Los Angeles International) | Los Angeles | CA | Major international gateway; hub for Delta, American, and United. |
| | SEA (Seattle–Tacoma International) | Seattle | WA | Hub for Alaska Airlines; gateway to the Pacific Northwest. |
| | SFO (San Francisco International) | San Francisco | CA | Major hub for United; key gateway to Asia. |
| | LAS (McCarran International) | Las Vegas | NV | Major hub for Southwest; high seasonal traffic due to tourism. |
| **Alaska & Hawaii** | ANC (Ted Stevens Anchorage International) | Anchorage | AK | Major refueling stop for transpacific flights; hub for Alaska Airlines. |
| | HNL (Honolulu International) | Honolulu | HI | Major hub for Hawaiian Airlines; gateway to the Pacific. |

These airports are among the busiest in terms of passenger traffic, flight operations, or both, and they serve as major hubs for several U.S. carriers.
